name: The Trapper
description: Sets and hides Bear Traps around the trial to catch and immobilize survivors.

name: The Wraith
description: Rings a bell to cloak himself, moving faster but unable to attack while invisible.

name: The Hillbilly
description: Revs up a chainsaw to sprint across the map and down survivors instantly.

name: The Nurse
description: Blinks short distances through obstacles, bypassing walls and pallets entirely.

name: The Shape
description: Stalks survivors to build power, eventually gaining speed and one-hit downs.

name: The Hag
description: Plants trap totems that teleport her to survivors who trigger them.

name: The Doctor
description: Emits electrical shocks that reveal and disorient nearby survivors.

name: The Huntress
description: Throws hatchets at survivors from a distance, injuring them without a chase.

name: The Cannibal
description: Revs a chainsaw for a wide sweeping attack that instantly downs survivors.

name: The Nightmare
description: Pulls survivors into a dream world where they move and act more slowly.

name: The Pig
description: Fits survivors with Reverse Bear Traps that must be removed before time runs out.

name: The Clown
description: Throws gas bottles that slow survivors caught in the toxic cloud.

name: The Spirit
description: Phases out of the physical realm to move quickly and track survivors by sound.

name: The Legion
description: Enters a frenzy to rapidly injure multiple survivors in quick succession.

name: The Plague
description: Vomits corruption onto survivors and objects, sickening anyone who interacts with them.

name: The Ghost Face
description: Stalks survivors while cloaked to mark them and approach undetected.

name: The Demogorgon
description: Opens portals to travel the Upside Down and ambush survivors from below.

name: The Oni
description: Collects blood orbs to transform into a demonic state with immense speed and power.

name: The Deathslinger
description: Fires a harpoon spear to reel survivors in from a distance.

name: The Executioner
description: Manifests torment creations and barriers throughout the trial grounds.

name: The Blight
description: Injects a serum to dash rapidly across the map, rebounding off obstacles.

name: The Twins
description: Controls a small companion, Victor, who can pounce on survivors from afar.

name: The Trickster
description: Throws a barrage of knives at survivors from range for stacking damage.

name: The Nemesis
description: Whips survivors with tentacle attacks that grow stronger and can zombify obstacles.

name: The Cenobite
description: Solves the Lament Configuration to summon chains that bind survivors in place.

name: The Artist
description: Summons crows to fly through the environment and injure survivors from afar.

name: The Onryō
description: Spreads cursed tapes and teleports through televisions across the trial.

name: The Dredge
description: Teleports between lockers and thrives when the trial descends into darkness.

name: The Mastermind
description: Infects survivors with the T-Virus, then leaps across the map with superhuman bounds.

name: The Knight
description: Summons loyal guards to patrol and hunt down survivors on his behalf.

name: The Skull Merchant
description: Deploys claw-trap drones that scan the area and slow down survivors caught nearby.

name: The Singularity
description: Deploys camera pods to teleport across the map and overload survivors.

name: The Xenomorph
description: Prowls through vents and crawlspaces before striking with a lethal tail attack.

name: The Good Guy
description: Hides in Hidey-Ho Mode among the crowd before striking with a butcher's knife.

name: The Unknown
description: Casts illusory UVX orbs that mark and injure survivors caught in its afterimage.

name: The Lich
description: Casts a variety of arcane spells, including flight and instant transportation.

name: The Dark Lord
description: Shapeshifts between forms, each granting a different power over the trial.

name: The Houndmaster
description: Commands a loyal hound to track and pounce on survivors across the trial.

name: The Ghoul
description: Grows stronger by feasting on despair, gaining speed and lasting map control.

name: The Animatronic
description: Uses jump scares and animatronic ambushes to stun and terrify survivors.

name: The Krasue
description: Detaches into a floating head with trailing entrails to fly silently through the trial.

name: The First
description: Uses psychic powers to manipulate generators and block survivor progress.

name: The Slasher
description: Delivers rapid, ferocious slash attacks that gain momentum the longer the trial runs.

name: The Judgment
description: Channels divine wrath to punish survivors and disrupt their progress from afar.
